svg.aria-label: Ethan Yu, AI engineer, building agents that show their work. 74 stars earned, 35 contributions in 2026, 33 tools in stack. I build AI agents that do real work and keep the receipts. Every claim they make is checked against evidence before it reaches a person, and the final call always stays with a human.
